value.rationale: This is a natural continuous degree filtration of canonical wheel graphs, previously investigated at the first and terminal stages. The new infinite-family integral barcode quantifies the exact births and deaths at all omitted intermediate degrees; the dihedral action then shows symmetry kills the quadratic-degree homology of the degree-two stage and identifies a sharp mod-four criterion for quotient rational homology. These are intrinsic motivated invariants, not arbitrary parameters or a small numerical gain.
